These bye-laws may be called the Dehu Road Cantonment Board (Non-refundable) Octroi Bye-Laws, 2011
The Central Govt. hereby notifies that Shri Surinder Singh has been elected from Ward Number 7 as a member of the Cantonment Board, Ferozepur in a casual election held on the 29 day of May, 2011.
The Central Govt. hereby makes the following rules, may be called the Cantonments (Payment of Allowances to Vice-President and Elected Members) Rules, 2011.
These rules may be called the Armed Forces Tribunal (Procedure) Amendment Rules, 2011.
The Central Govt. hereby notifies the Bench of the Armed Forces Tribunal at Mumbai with effect from 9 day of June, 2011.
Central Government hereby fixes the 29th May, 2011 (Sunday) as the date on which a casual election to the Cantonment Board, Ferozepur in respect of Ward Number 7, shall be held.
The Central Govt. hereby notifies that Shri Govind Yadav has been elected from Ward Number-7 as a member of the Cantonment Board, Jabalpur in a casual election held on the 19th day of December, 2010.
